findings.comment: `it.only` focuses this single test and causes test runners (e.g. Jest) to skip all other tests in the file or suite, which can mask regressions in CI.

When `ensureFormComponentIsStateful` upgrades a form fiber, it creates a single Hook object whose `next` pointer is `null`. Requiring `existingStateHook.next !== null` prevents the function from recognizing an already-upgraded fiber, causing it to overwrite `formFiber.memoizedState` and its queue on subsequent submissions. Furthermore, this change conflicts with the PR description, which indicates the PR was only meant to add a test.

verdicts.reason: Finding 1 accurately identifies that requiring `existingStateHook.next !== null` prevents single-hook form components from being recognized as already stateful, matching the reference comment.
